name: Kwan's International Co., Ltd.
summary: Kwan's International Co., Ltd., along with its affiliated businesses, primarily operates within the film and television cultural sector. Its extensive range of activities includes the wholesale and retail of cultural, educational, and musical instrument products, as well as school supplies. The company also undertakes the publication of magazines, books, and audiobooks; engages in film creation and distribution; orchestrates performing arts events; broadcasts video programs; and organizes concerts. Furthermore, it delivers general advertising services and a variety of arts and cultural offerings. Diversifying its portfolio, Kwan's International is also involved in the manufacturing, processing, and sale of printed circuit boards and insulating board materials. Established in Taipei, Taiwan, in 1978, the company was previously known as Victory Circuit Co., Ltd. until its rebranding in August 2017.
